questions.markdown: Read the comprehension passage and answer the questions on it.

According to the writer, ‘the war in Ukraine’

a. Has affected India more than it affected the rest of the world
b. Has affected India as well as the rest of the world
c. Has not affected India as much as it affected the rest of the world
d. Has not affected India as it remained indifferent

Which of the following is not correct according to the passage?

a. Indian economy may be hurt by rise in oil prices due to war in Ukraine
b. Indian economy may be hurt by rise in wheat prices due to war in Ukraine
c. Indian economy may be hurt by rise in sunflower oil prices due to war in Ukraine
d. Indian economy may be hurt by rise in prices on agricultural commodities due to war in Ukraine

Global wheat shortage is likely to extend for a longer period because

a. 41 million people in west and central Africa face a food and nutrition crisis
b. Ukraine may produce the required wheat crop only after the war stops
c. Wheat in Ukraine’s granaries risks rotting uneaten because the war has made it impossible to ship it out
d. Countries like Egypt, Turkey, Bangladesh and Iran do not import wheat from Russia

According to the author ‘economic sanctions on Russia’

a. Is likely to end the war on Ukraine
b. Will have spill over effect on European economies
c. Will help the developing economies to control inflation
d. Is likely to help Ukraine to fight the war

questions.markdown:
The war on Ukraine has shown that

a. local war in the 21st century is not limited to the region
b. globalised world is able to sustain the impact of war due to interdependence
c. developing economies are the worst hit when the war takes place
d. countries should protect the borders to minimise the impact of war

The rise in oil price as well as prices of agricultural commodities ...............economies of the nations across of the globe.

a. has influenced
b. have influenced
c. are influencing
d. influencing

Neither ...............European country nor .................Asian country can remain indifferent to the crisis at this point of time.

a. a, an
b. an, an
c. the, a
d. an, a

Countries that had just begun to recover from the devastating consequences of the pandemic and associated lockdowns have now been hit with a “double whammy”.

The word ‘double whammy’ means

a. a situation that is bad in two different ways
b. a situation that warrants immediate action
c. a situation that is unprecedented
d. a situation that requires two different solutions

...had he been the steward of good times rather than presiding ‘haplessly’ over economic failure

The word ‘haplessly’ means

a. casually
b. unfortunately
c. providentially
d. dejectedly

questions.markdown:
The conflict between Russia and Ukraine ...................going on ........2014 when Russia invaded Crimea.

a. has been, since
b. have been, since
c. is, since
d. have been, for

Answer the following in about 300 words:

Our globalised world is simply less able to cope with war.

Do you agree with the view? Substantiate your response.

Answer the following in 300-400 words:

Is there a need to emphasize the importance of humanities in a world that is increasingly tending towards science and technology? Accordingly, should the curriculum in educational institutions be revamped? Substantiate your answer with reference to the texts discussed in class.

Answer the following in 300-400 words:

What are the traits and values that make an individual successful in professional and personal life? Are these traits universal? Substantiate your answer with reference to the texts discussed in class.

Write an essay on any ONE of the following in 500-600 words.

1. English will be the only global language in the future.
2. Will there be a Time when further Technological Advancements will stop?
